# shellcheck when installed, else bash -n; python scripts byte-compile.
check-scripts:
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "$root"
    files=(); py=()
    for f in scripts/* .agents/skills/herdr-comms/assets/* tests/*; do
      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue   # tests/fixtures/ holds data, not scripts
      if head -1 "$f" | grep -q python; then py+=("$f"); else files+=("$f"); fi
    done
    for f in "${py[@]}"; do python3 -c 'import ast,sys; ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1]).read(), sys.argv[1])' "$f"; done
    echo "python: ok (${#py[@]} files)"
    if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null; then
      shellcheck -S warning "${files[@]}"; echo "scripts: shellcheck ok (${#files[@]} files)"
    else
      for f in "${files[@]}"; do bash -n "$f"; done; echo "scripts: bash -n ok (${#files[@]} files; shellcheck not installed)"
    fi
    for f in "${files[@]}" "${py[@]}"; do [[ -x "$f" ]] || { echo "not executable: $f" >&2; exit 1; }; done

the parent just's argv, the --justfile/-f it was given (`just --justfile X
--working-directory Y` runs backticks in Y, not beside X).

Stdout is exactly `gate-free: ok` on pass; the justfile treats anything else
as failure. Fails closed: a just error, unparsable dump or unexpected shape
exits 2 with a message, never ok. Stdlib only.

    """Every `Verdict: clear|blocking` line outside fenced code blocks and blockquotes, in order."""

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""grade-review.py FINAL.txt TEST...: the reviewer's final report blocks each named test.

Blocked verdict: a paragraph naming 'verdict' and 'block'. A test is blocked when its name
appears in a section whose heading says block (not non-blocking), or in a paragraph or list
item that says block (not non-blocking/note). Prints per test; PASS when all hold.
"""
import re, sys

text = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read()
BLOCK = re.compile(r"(?<!non-)block", re.I)
verdict = any(re.search(r"verdict", p, re.I) and BLOCK.search(p) for p in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", text))
sections = re.split(r"\n(?=#+ )", "\n" + text)
blocked = ""
for s in sections:
    head, _, body = s.strip().partition("\n")
    if head.startswith("#") and BLOCK.search(head) and not re.search(r"non-block|note", head, re.I):
        blocked += body + "\n"
for c in re.split(r"\n\s*\n|\n(?=\s*(?:[-*]|\d+\.)\s)", text):
    if BLOCK.search(c) and not re.search(r"non-block", c, re.I):
        blocked += c + "\n"
ok = verdict
print(f"verdict blocked: {verdict}")
for t in sys.argv[2:]:
    hit = t in blocked
    print(f"{t}: {'blocked' if hit else 'NOT blocked'}")
    ok = ok and hit
print("PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
